declared.quantiles: type 7 (linear between order statistics) unless a legacy twin mirrors another rule
declared.medianFootprint: type-7 median of footprint areas and minimum-area-rectangle short sides, per map
declared.block: a bounded face of the drawn-centreline way graph (street corridors not inset); built = holds >= 1 footprint area centroid
declared.builtOutline: the convex hull of every footprint vertex (V12 names no rule for a source without walls)
declared.attachedPrimary: any shared length > 0 (V12 literal); adjacency minimum reported

court.radius: polylabel on the face polygon, precision 1 % of the short side

junction.internalConnector: a chain with both ends in one merged cluster and length <= 2 x the merge distance

declared.registration: footprints moved into the road canvas frame by the adapter (screenshot registration); cross-layer measures repeated at +-1 px

sample.kind: recorded seeds 7171 and 7172 per template at medium (twin fixtures; plan-check PC-04: rows need W-04's plan seeds or a recorded-sample ruling)

bldg.pairing.definition: reading B (primary): exactly one neighbour that both shares >= 50 % of one of the footprint's edges and has an area within +-25 %; reading A: exactly one neighbour shares >= 50 % of an edge, and its area is within +-25 %

blockMinorExtentRel.definition: built blocks: minimum-area rectangle short side of the drawn-centreline face / the median footprint short side

footprintFrontage.definition: per footprint in a block: extents along and across its nearest block-boundary edge (drawn centreline), and its least distance to that edge; / the median footprint short side; front row = least distance <= 1.00 x that side

raster.connectivity: 4 for components, 8 for touching the edge
